title: a Page owner announces something, with a time on it

criteria.text: Only a Page's managing role can announce or edit; anyone else sees no control and a direct write is refused; an edit happens in place and stays the same announcement
criteria.note: `requireManagingRole` (via `managingRoleForKind`) gates `group.post_create`, `group.post_edit` and `group.post_delete`; an edit is an `update` of the same row id [V src/actions/group/post.ts]. Checked: no `[guards F072.n]` marker anywhere [V grep]; `post.test.ts` and `PagePosts.test.tsx` are unmarked (#599). Reviewed: built by #115 and #183, neither carries `Reviewed by:` [V gh]. Shipped: Deploy health green on cff5bbf (#183); no run on f680032 (#115, predates the workflow), so unknown [V].

Retired: Don, 2026-10-02, on #318: "There's no way to delete an announcement", which the Issue says replaces F072's no-delete under newer-decision-wins; built as `group.post_delete` (soft delete, `dissolved_at`) in #319 [V gh, post.ts]. Not yet a dated line in the scenario's `## Rulings`; `sync-roadmap` should record it. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: An announcement appears on its Page and in browse, reading as coming from the Page and not as a listing: no price, no buy control, no listing chrome
criteria.note: Posts show on their Page and in Explore as the Page's, with no price or buy control in the composer, `PagePosts.tsx` or the browse cards [V grep]. #1459 (11-26) made Explore a list at every width; the post cards are unchanged [V git show]. Checked: unmarked tests; nothing scans for listing chrome (#599, #601). Reviewed: #1126, #1143, #1168, #1170 carry `Reviewed by:`; #115, #183, #258 and #1140 do not [V]. Shipped: green on each merge commit [V]. Smoked: the 11-26 smoke-live on 71107bc opened the page routes and was red on operator/page and member/page-business; the 11-25 green run opened only explore routes [V gh run].

criteria.text: One whose start time has passed stops appearing in browse, with no manual cleanup
criteria.note: Retired by F121 `## Rulings` 2026-10-30: timely posts leave the shelves and lists at a shelf life set by kind; "shelf life is when a post ends" [V scenario-F121.md]. Built as `post_current_until` / `SHELF_DAYS` (#1126). Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: One with no event date leaves browse after 14 days and moves to an Earlier section on its Page, unless its owner set a show-until date; it shows Posted <date>
criteria.note: Retired by the same F121 ruling (2026-10-30): an undated post leaves at its kind's shelf life and sits under Past on its Page, replacing the 2026-10-02 14-day rule and Earlier section [V kinds.ts, scenario-F121.md]. Shown, not counted; `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario.

criteria.text: The composer takes an optional date and time and an optional address of its own; a start is returned by a time-windowed read to the hour; an undated post is never returned by one; times are the metro's
criteria.note: `group.post_create` writes `starts_at`, `ends_at` and `location_id`; `browse_feed` (last in 20261031120000_post_kinds.sql) compares timestamptz bounds; `METRO_TIME_ZONE` is one constant until the metro carries its own zone (#173, open) [V]. Checked: unmarked `metro-time.test.ts`, `post.test.ts`, `tests/announcement-card-db.test.ts` (#599). Reviewed: #183, #212, #258 have no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped: green on cff5bbf, ea90c1e, 82da793 [V]. Smoked: no smoke route opens the composer or a time window.

criteria.text: One switch for who it reaches, defaulting to anyone; the words name the people, neither "announcement" nor "bulletin" is in any label; beside the restricted setting a live count that reads as words at zero
criteria.note: `AudienceSwitch.tsx`: Anyone by default, the restricted setting visible but not postable (delivery is cut), the count in words at zero [V]. Checked: one unmarked label test in `PagePosts.test.tsx`; nothing scans every label (#601, #599). Reviewed: #183 has no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped: green on cff5bbf. Smoked: no smoke route opens the composer.

criteria.text: An announcement that fails to save leaves nothing behind: no half-made row on the Page, in browse or in its history
criteria.note: `group.post_create` inserts the post and its tags in one transaction; a failure rolls back [V post.ts]. Checked: unmarked tests; no guard (#599). Reviewed: #183 none. Shipped: green on cff5bbf.

criteria.text: An announcement or gathering may carry an optional end time; one with a time offers add-to-calendar; its image carries default alt text built from title, date and place; the label stays Event
criteria.note: Half built: `ends_at` (#263), `AddToCalendarLink` with DTEND (#261), and title-date-place alt text on browse cards [V]. Missing: a Page's own post photo still takes the post's first line as alt (`PagePosts.tsx:699`), with no title-date-place fallback (#596). No commit touched it since 11-06 [V git log].
